description: Ministry of Labour - Notify the appointments of members to the Wages Boards for the Prawn Culture and Export Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes a Wages Board for a specific trade sector (Prawn Culture and Export Trade) under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It contains regulatory content about the appointment of board members to fulfill statutory requirements under existing legislation. While it mentions the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under a regulatory framework rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory in nature, falling under legal/regulatory matters.
